title: A sustainable one-pot multi-component approach toward the synthesis of symmetric and unsymmetrical spiro heterocycles catalyzed by the Brønsted acidic ionic liquid [CMMIM][BF4]
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21953-21966
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01721E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rujuma Begum, Barnali Maiti
An efficient and sustainable one-pot protocol has been developed for the synthesis of spiroxanthene and spirochromenecarboxylate derivatives using 5–6 mol% of the Brønsted acidic ionic liquid [CMMIM][BF4] in aqueous ethanol media with high yields.
